title: Stop Loss
description: A new weapon that drops steel jaws where you stand: the first grizzly to step in is stuck for 3 seconds and takes a big hit.

title: Short Squeeze
description: Get surrounded by 30 bears and the bull squeezes: a green shockwave throws every bear on screen off it.

title: Paper Hands Panic
description: Every so often a crowd of paper hands panic-sells in a line across the screen, and you dodge the stampede.
